newsitem.title: USA: ACNielsen expands consumer panel markets.
newsitem.headline: ACNielsen expands consumer panel markets.

text.p: ACNielsen Corp said Monday it has expanded its Homescan Consumer Panel to 52,000 U.S. households from 40,000 in order to improve its consumer purchase information database.

The market research company said it significantly increased its sample of households in New York, Chicago and Los Angeles, and added Atlanta, Baltimore/Washington D.C. and San Antonio to its market roster.
ACNeilsen said the Homescan program currently covers 19 U.S. markets.
The company's shares were up 1/8 Monday at 14-3/8.
